sections.title: Growth and habitat
sections.text: Puccinellia maritima is a perennial tuft-forming grass of coastal salt marshes. It also spreads by creeping stolons.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Its culms are about 10–80 cm tall. The narrow leaves are about 2–20 cm long and 1–3 mm wide; the open panicle measures about 3–25 cm.

sections.title: Food and toxicity
sections.text: The references consulted do not establish a human food use or a notable toxicity for this species.
